title: Transit newsletters — HMRC updates
text:
These newsletters are published by HMRC to update you on the latest news and updates for moving goods using transit.

 You can find earlier newsletters on the National Archives website for:

 • 2023 to 2024 

 • 2020 to 2022 

 • 2017 to 2019 

 • 2014 to 2016
changeNote: The 'September 2026 — future customs infrastructure arrangements at Sevington and Holyhead inland border facilities' newsletter has been added.
